maddeler.e:
ننطبق (form VII)
# نَنْطَبِقُ (nanṭabiqu) /nan.tˤa.bi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# نَنْطَبِقَ (nanṭabiqa) /nan.tˤa.bi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
# نَنْطَبِقْ (nanṭabiq) /nan.tˤa.biq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَبَقَ (inṭabaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
